override_evm_target.reason: Cancun is the target that makes the 'mcopy' built-in available, so pinning every version to it is the only way to show the language-version gate deciding on its own.

expected_solc_divergence.reason: Cancun support only arrives in solc 0.8.24, so every version here declines the target outright ('Invalid EVM version requested'), which counts as a rejection. slang analyzes the input and accepts the declaration, which is the point of this test.
